title: A Kormány és a végrehajtó hatalom (The Government & Executive Power)
grammar: Institutional Governance, Separation of Powers & Public Law in Hungarian

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say who leads the Government and how the Prime Minister and the ministers are chosen.
I can say that the Government is accountable to the National Assembly.
I can say that the Prime Minister's office is in the Carmelite Monastery in Buda Castle.
I can read a short text about the Government.
